rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-approved programs or programs approved by the Mississippi Board of Pharmacy before presentation; CE accepted by another state's pharmacy board or by another approved health care regulatory agency for dual licensees
rules.alternatives: Full-time students in a recognized school of the healing arts may get CE credit on proof of enrollment; extensions/waivers possible for active military.
rules.audit_note: Proof of CE must reach the Board within 5 working days of a request.

topics.who: Opioid abuse and prevention or another drug-of-abuse / addiction-related issue

rules.notes: Annual license period Jan 1–Dec 31; renewal after Dec 31 costs a $50 late fee. At least 2 hours each year must be live (live webcasts count). Pharmacists must be registered PMP users. Fee: $100 + $5 impaired-pharmacist surcharge.
rules.legal_basis: Mississippi Board of Pharmacy Regulations, Article IV License Renewal and Continuing Education
